registry: pill_builder.js (used as-is — same renderer as erp.html, NO second framework)
note: SIBLING manifest for the iDempiere renderer surface (idempiere.html) — DECIDED separate from erp.html's pills.json (GATE-1, ERP_BOTTOM_BAR_AND_LIFECYCLE.md §RESUME): the action sets differ. fn bound BY ID in idmp_pills.js to the REAL existing idempiere.html handlers (window.IdmpPillActions — functions are not JSON). icon = a glyph in icons.js (verbatim from viewer/panels.js); nothing inlined, nothing hand-drawn. Retires the hand-rolled #idmp-pillrail (§PILL-REGISTRY principle: no controls outside the pill).

pills.name: Just the pill / classic L&F
pills.note: §D ERP_BOTTOM_BAR_AND_LIFECYCLE — master toggle. OUR design (default) = just the pill: classic iDempiere chrome (toolbar icons) hidden, the pill IS the UI. Press red pill (or ',' — same shortcut as BIM Doc Mode) → reveal the familiar iDempiere L&F; in classic mode our lens pills step aside (only the red pill remains). Persisted in localStorage. NEVER stage-gated.

pills.name: New record
pills.note: GRID_BATCH_FORM_PILL_SPEC item 5 — the iDempiere New toolbar action relocated into the pill (red-pill 'just the pill' hides #idmp-toolbar). Opens the CRUD ring on the current table (New/Save/Delete bundled — reuses _openCrudRing, the SAME logic as the ✎ CRUD toolbar button; never forks the verb). §AD-GATE showWhen:form-view — surfaces only with a record open in FORM view (IdmpPillFormGate); off the bar in grid / at the front door. plus glyph (Lucide verbatim).

pills.name: Save
pills.note: GRID_BATCH_FORM_PILL_SPEC item 5 — the iDempiere Save toolbar action: commits the edits in the open CRUD overlay form (clicks its #cfSave). Honest toast when nothing is being edited. §AD-GATE showWhen:form-view. save glyph (Lucide verbatim, already in icons.js).

pills.name: Process
pills.note: GRID_BATCH_FORM_PILL_SPEC item 5 — the iDempiere Process ▶ (DocAction) toolbar action: opens a chooser of the current record's LEGAL FSM action set (the _fsmCtx seam, same AdDocFsm path as the form DocAction bar and the grid batch bar). Click dispatches in-memory + repaints. §AD-GATE showWhen:form-view. next glyph (forward arrow, Lucide verbatim). Print maps to the existing `reports` pill (NON-INVENT, no duplicate).

pills.name: Accts Posted
pills.note: per-record accounting fold (openPostedFor) — journal-lines clipboard glyph.

pills.name: Reports
pills.note: Financial statements + receipt report menu (window.__report.menu → report_overlay.js openMenu). Replaces the former #reportMenuPill fixed float (PR #295 legacy) — reports are now a registry pill, no controls outside the pill bar.

pills.name: Posting Preview
pills.note: per-record DocAction preview (openPreviewFor) — the journal Complete WOULD post, PURE (no write); reuses AcctsPosted renderer via window.ERPPreview. doc glyph (report/document). §AD-GATE showWhen:posting-doc — mirrors iDempiere's AD `Posted` Button field: the pill surfaces ONLY when a posting document (table carrying the `Posted` column, AD_Reference=28) is open; off the bar otherwise. Lights to-the-cent on a tenant db carrying posting config.

pills.name: Edit mode
pills.note: Toggle CRUD Edit-mode ring on/off (window.__crud.toggleEditMode). Lit when edit mode is active (IdmpPillActive.editmode). Replaces the former #crudModeWrap fixed float — edit mode is now a registry pill, consistent with the pill-only surface convention.

pills.name: Kanban
pills.note: draggable wfmc board / heat-map fallback (openKanbanFor) — board-columns layout glyph.

pills.name: Rule
pills.note: lifecycle-as-data governance gate (openRuleFor) — compliance checkList glyph.

pills.name: POS
pills.note: POS_ADDON_SPEC §P-1 — the point-of-sale lens (openPosFor → PosLens.open): c_poskey tile grid, sealed master prices, Complete = ONE signed group (order+ship+invoice+backflush, WR from the dictionary), replenishment fold after. shopping-cart glyph (Lucide verbatim). §AD-GATE showWhen:pos-station — surfaces only when the tenant carries a c_pos row (window.IdmpPillPosGate, mirrors the Posting-Preview data-gate).

pills.name: Warehouse Walk
pills.note: Opens the warehouse walk viewer (§S-1 compiled GardenWorld db, short GH Pages URL). Static demo door — no data gate (the walk pill inside the viewer already gates on locator bins). share = navigator.share the viewer URL.

pills.name: Excel Report
pills.note: NinjaExcelAdaptation.md §6.2 — Excel-as-report-binder lens (window.NinjaPill): drop a filled sample (BACKUP) → MAKE scaffolds Input+Process; drop the authored workbook → RUN folds each Process row over the loaded tenant db (sql.js), writes values to the addressed cells, verify-by-example vs the sample (integer cents), download filled. The browser never renders the report — formatting/subtotals/charts stay the user's own Excel. grid glyph (spreadsheet). Engine == bim-compiler build/erp (W-NINJA/MAKE/RULE headless + W-NINJA-PILL live).

pills.name: Read / Compare
pills.note: Migrate & Compare evaluator paper (migrate_compare.html) — same lightbulb pill as erp.html's erpdoc. Houses the 'How this compares' experience in a pill (was a free-floating login-card link). Bound to openReadCompare in idmp_pills.js → window.IdmpPillActions. NEVER stage-gated (always reachable).

pills.name: ShowMe Help
pills.note: §P3-REOPENED (FRONT_DOOR_PILL_FINISH): guided ShowMe/NeedHelp tour, now a CLEAN Lucide circleHelp PILL (was a header '?' text glyph + a floating 'NeedHelp?' checkbox outside the pill). TOGGLE — IdmpPillActions.showme flips the shared help_overlay.js #needHelpCk (no fork), lit via IdmpPillActive.showme = ck.checked. NOT stage-gated (help is always useful). The floating #needHelpWrap is CSS-hidden on this surface; the pill is the sole control.

pills.name: Plugin Engine
pills.note: PLUGIN_SYSTEM_LANE.md §Phase D — the Fold-Engine plugin host (W-PLUGIN). TAP opens PluginEngine.open: paste a raw ES-module bundle URL → one click → ACTIVE (collapses iDempiere's drop-JAR-restart + 2Pack-import into one in-surface action). A bundle contributes into the live engine registries (AdModelVal/AdCallout/AdProcess/PostResolver) via plugin_registry.js; state persists in IndexedDB. plug glyph (Lucide verbatim). NEVER stage-gated (engine plugins are a global concern). §-witness §PLUGIN-PILL.

pills.name: Sound FX
pills.note: The SAME Sound-FX speaker pill as the BIM viewer (panels.js id=audio, key v) — idempiere.html loads ../viewer/sfx.js so window.toggleSfx + window.__sfx are present. TAP toggles the ERP/POS earcons (POS ring/pay/complete, §R2-AUDIO); lit when on (IdmpPillActive.audio → __sfx.isOn()), live-synced via builder.sync(). The choice PERSISTS (localStorage sfx_on overrides erp/sfx.json master.enabled), so a mute sticks across reloads — surfaces the control instead of an invisible default. volume2 glyph (Lucide verbatim, already in icons.js). [[feedback_pill_icon_consistency]].

pills.name: World History
pills.note: HISTORY_KNOB_DIAL.md — the cross-page History overlay (which building/doc/page). TAP = open the across-pages overlay (WholeHistory.toggleOpen); LONG-PRESS = a drawer with Z (this page's dot-timeline bar = IdmpHistory) + bomb (clear history, warns first; no shortcut). Replaces the standalone bottom-left clock launcher (WholeHistory mounts {launcher:false}). Two-overlapping-circles glyph. NEVER stage-gated (history is useful anywhere).
